h1: Lead scoring that marks your best-fit leads
overview: Not every lead deserves the same attention. We build a simple scoring system in your own CRM or email tool that gives each lead points for fit, such as budget, location and service wanted, and for actions such as opening emails or booking a call. Hot leads are flagged and sent to you first. The rules are written in plain words, so you can understand and adjust them as you learn.

faq: Do I need a lot of leads for scoring?
No. A few dozen is enough to start with sensible fit rules. As leads and sales build up, the rules can be tuned, and Premium uses your past leads to check the model.
Which CRMs can you build scoring in?
HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, ActiveCampaign and similar tools, within what your plan allows. Some tools only offer scoring on higher plans, and we tell you before we start.
Is it fair to score people?
We score on business fit and engagement only. We do not use sensitive personal traits, and the rules are written down so you can review them.
Will scoring tell me who will certainly buy?
No. A score is a guide for where to look first, not a prediction. It helps you reply sooner to likely buyers, and you still decide who to call.
